_comment: Single source of truth for system-wide energy/power policy on the Surface Pro 8 host. All thresholds, idle timers, lid/power-button behaviour, and CPU profile bindings live here. Consumed by host modules (configuration_security.nix, configuration_power.nix) and the home-manager flake (ba_flakes_desktop/.../plasma.nix → PowerDevil + kscreenlockerrc). Replicated verbatim in ba_flakes_desktop/src/modules/desktop/cloud-data-power.json because Nix pure-eval flakes cannot read paths outside their own source root. The battery-watchdog (cloud-data-battery-protection.json) keeps its own per-voter thresholds: those describe the LAST-RESORT tier that does not trust the SAM data path.

thresholds._comment: Battery percentage thresholds shared by upowerd, PowerDevil notifications, and the watchdog's bat_capacity/bat_energy_ratio voters. critical_pct is where every healthy-SAM path tries to hibernate; the watchdog plus its 5 SAM-independent voters (stuck_sam, voltage_under_min, firmware_alarm, adp_offline_time, bat_energy_ratio) are the true safety net when SAM lies.

idle_minutes._comment: Minutes of user inactivity before each step. lock applies on both AC and Battery (security is power-source-independent). hibernate is the only AC-vs-Battery split: AC trusts the user (long fail-safe so a build/download isn't killed), Battery defends the work (shorter). null disables a step.

events._comment: Hardware-event handlers. Allowed verbs: lock, ignore, hibernate, poweroff. Sleep/suspend are never permitted (see actions.never).

actions._comment: Verb policy. critical = what every layer tries on critical-battery hit. low/warn = notification-only. The 'never' list is a HARD GUARD: every consumer reading this JSON MUST refuse to emit configuration that maps any event/threshold to a banned verb. Surface Pro 8 SAM/DRM suspend (S3, s2idle) is unreliable: surface_hid reprobe fails, DRM atomic commit errors, logind marks the session Active=no which makes kscreenlocker reject correct passwords. Therefore sleep/suspend stay banned forever — use hibernate or lock instead.

pre_hibernate_warning._comment: Universal pre-hibernate countdown. Injects an ExecStartPre on systemd-hibernate.service so EVERY hibernation path (battery-watchdog, UPower critical, KDE Plasma idle, manual `systemctl hibernate`) is delayed by `delay_minutes` and announces itself first via journal + wall + notify-send. Cancel with: `sudo systemctl stop systemd-hibernate.service`. Set delay_minutes=0 to disable the warning entirely (immediate hibernate). channels.* gate which announcement vectors are used.
pre_hibernate_warning._status_note: DISABLED 2026-06-12 to match reality: configuration_pre-hibernate-warning.nix was removed from configuration.nix imports in the post-2026-05-16 simplification (UX-only module; the write-safety gates came back, this did not). Its tester checks were removed from testers.checks for the same reason. Re-import the module AND restore the checks together if re-enabling.

kernel._comment: Kernel power-management cmdline options. mem_sleep_default=deep forces S3 over s2idle so any rogue suspend attempt fails fast (S3 is broken too, but at least it errors out instead of half-sleeping forever in s2idle). Appended to boot.kernelParams.

cpu_profile._comment: power-profiles-daemon profile target per power source. Auto-switching is driven by the KDE Plasma battery applet; this is the declared intent — the runtime daemon honors it. Not enforced in a service; informational + future-driven.

testers._comment: Each invariant verifies one consumer is using the configured value. Run after any threshold/timer change.

checks.description: logind lid action on battery matches events.lid_close.battery (logind keys are NOT exposed via systemctl show — read the conf file directly)
logind lid action on AC matches events.lid_close.ac
logind lid action when docked matches events.lid_close.docked
logind HandlePowerKey matches events.power_button.short (last-occurrence wins per systemd-logind merge order)

kernel cmdline forces deep sleep (no s2idle) per kernel.mem_sleep_default. Reads /proc/cmdline (always-current truth, bootloader-agnostic). Requires a reboot for changes from boot.json to take effect.
PowerDevil BatteryCriticalLevel matches thresholds.critical_pct (run as user)
PowerDevil BatteryLowLevel matches thresholds.low_pct (run as user)
PowerDevil [Battery][SuspendAndShutdown] AutoSuspendIdleTimeoutSec matches idle_minutes.battery.hibernate*60 (run as user)
PowerDevil [AC][SuspendAndShutdown] AutoSuspendIdleTimeoutSec matches idle_minutes.ac.hibernate*60 (run as user)
kscreenlockerrc Daemon.Timeout (minutes) matches idle_minutes.battery.lock (run as user)

deployment._comment: After editing this JSON, the host flake AND the home-manager flake both need a switch (each consumes its own replica).
